notes: The realms' ambience loops (realmAmbientBed.ts). Render with yarn audio:ace-step:realm (from a worktree, set CROSS_REPO_LIBS_ROOT to the cross-repo-libs checkout and ACESTEP_PYTHON to the main checkout's .venv-audio python), rank the takes with pick-ace-takes.py, cut each winner with make-seamless-loop.py and encode it to src/renderer/assets/audio/music/realm/<realm>-ambience.ogg. A job takes only ACE-Step GenerationParams keys, so the target is named here, not on the job. Beatless on purpose: the bed is not locked to the run loop's beat, so a pulse at the same tempo would drift against it; the key (A minor, the run music's A, B, D, E frame) is what keeps the two together. The first takes, asked for a 75 BPM feel, came out as beat loops; the beatless wording reduced the pulse on the XL-turbo model but did not remove it, so audition every take before installing one (the game plays any file in that folder).
